package.name: hyper_camera
package.description: USB camera driver node for HYPER's one physical camera, the Logitech C920, as a C++ rclcpp component. It publishes a plain sensor_msgs/Image topic instead of each consumer opening the device itself, so lane_detection can load it into the same component container for zero-copy intra-process delivery while object_detection_node subscribes to the same frames over DDS. Also the distribution point for the camera's config files.
